voievodat.name: The Principality
voievodat.description: Men of the valleys. Strong walls, steady coin, and church bells that unsettle the creatures of the night.
voievodat.legend: Churches: their bells calm the people and weaken any creature that fights nearby. Strong treasury (+25% income).

ai.summary: Keeps their word and defends what is theirs.

zmei.name: The Dragonkin
zmei.description: Dragon-blooded lords of the high peaks. Few in number, terrible in battle, and greedy beyond measure.
zmei.legend: The Hoard: gold breeds gold (+30% income, and interest on the treasury). Their lords can abduct a rival's heir and demand a ransom.

ai.summary: Picks fights with the weak and can be bought with gold.

iele.name: The Fae Court
iele.description: Wild fairies of the deep woods. Swift and unseen among the trees, their endless dance drives intruders mad.
iele.legend: The Hora: enemies on Fae land are danced to exhaustion each season. In the forests their armies cannot be seen.

ai.summary: Seldom starts a war and is quick to make peace.

strigoi.name: The Revenants
strigoi.description: The restless dead of the marshes. Cheap, countless and slow, and stronger with every grave they open.
strigoi.legend: Raise the dead: after every victory the fallen of both sides rise to join them. They feel no cold and strike harder in winter.

ai.summary: Always hungry for more land; hates the living Principality.

outlaws.name: The Outlaws
outlaws.description: Haiduci of the deep woods, who rob the rich boyars and are sung of by the poor. Quick, poor and loved.
outlaws.legend: Rob the rich: every province they take fills their purse with 40 gold. The poor love them: +1 order in every province.

ai.summary: Raids the rich and weak, makes friends among the poor.

solomonari.name: The Solomonari
solomonari.description: Wizards of the school under the earth, who ride dragons through the storm clouds and call down hail on their foes.
solomonari.legend: Lords of the weather: storm and hail follow them, so enemy arrows and guns strike 20% weaker. They feel no cold.

ai.summary: Keeps to the mountains and strikes only when sure of victory.

haiduci.name: Rebels
haiduci.description: Brigands of the forests who rise wherever lords rule badly.
haiduci.legend: They rise wherever public order collapses.

hungary.name: Kingdom of Hungary
hungary.description: The crown of Saint Stephen, master of the plains to the west.
hungary.legend: The crown of Saint Stephen, master of the plains to the west.

poland.name: Kingdom of Poland
poland.description: The Polish crown and its hussars, beyond the northern forests.
poland.legend: The Polish crown and its hussars, beyond the northern forests.

ottomans.name: The Sultan
ottomans.description: The Sultan's armies beyond the Danube: they raid for slaves and plunder, unless paid tribute.
ottomans.legend: The Sultan's armies beyond the Danube: they raid for slaves and plunder, unless paid tribute.

tatars.name: The Tatars
tatars.description: Horsemen of the Wild Fields, who ride in to burn and plunder and are gone before the bells stop ringing.
tatars.legend: Horsemen of the Wild Fields, who ride in to burn and plunder and are gone before the bells stop ringing.
